issues.description: Method mismatch for Lecture.addGuestStudents: the problem statement and UML specify a method addGuestStudents(int, String) that accepts an integer and a reason String (problem_statement.md). The solution implementation in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java defines addGuestStudents with only a single int parameter (public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents)) at line 90. This disagreement about the parameter list will confuse students implementing or calling the method and can cause compilation or test failures if automated tests or the exercise text expect the two-parameter signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the artifacts consistent. Either update the solution implementation to match the specification by changing the method signature to: public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, String reason) and handle or store/log the reason (e.g., a simple assignment, append to a log, or ignore but accept the parameter), or update the problem statement and UML to require only addGuestStudents(int) if the reason parameter is unnecessary. Also ensure any tests or example calls use the chosen signature.
